verdict.rationale: Kintsugi is an automated sales-tax compliance platform. A buyer could reasonably ask whether its automated rules or configurations can be versioned, reviewed, and reverted, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers connectors, transaction sync, the API, SDKs, API keys, nexus, filings, and a docs-only MCP server, but never mentions versioning, review workflows, or rollback of automations or configurations.
